subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers continue repairing this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote one of the broader sibling PRs instead?
rationale: Multiple open candidate PRs target the same bug, and this branch still has concrete code blockers plus a contributor proof gap, so choosing the canonical landing branch needs maintainer coordination.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge

options.title: Promote a broader sibling
options.body: If maintainers prefer a sibling with broader proof-positive coverage, preserve useful context there and pause or close this branch after the canonical fix is selected.
